units.marketingTitle: A One-Bedroom with a north-facing perspective
units.description:

units.marketingTitle: A Kitchen Island, Split Bedrooms, and a Balcony to Unwind

Live where city life meets sophistication—this is more than an apartment; it’s your masterpiece.
